C0084.title: Douyin Streamer Detained After Displaying Pornographic QR Code During Livestream
C0084.summary: Douyin platform detected a streamer who, after gaining viewer traction, suddenly displayed a pornographic traffic-diversion QR code to guide viewers into downloading a hookup app. The platform immediately banned the account's livestream permissions and reported the leads to police.
